DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_LilyQueen:
When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals and revives any fainted pals.
Converts own attacks to grass damage, increases grass damage by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>, and reduces own active skill cooldowns by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue3}%</>.
